messages:
ana (PM): Quick sync — Q2 GTM split/priority planning. We need one clear list: launches, PLG experiments, and enablement. Can folks drop top 2 asks from your side + one hard constraint?
tara (Product Marketing): From PMM: 1) Launch microsite + demo flows for Dedicated. 2) 1-pager + templates for AE outbound. Constraint: design capacity limited first 3 weeks.
mike (Growth): Growth asks: 1) PLG experiment — contextual onboarding for embeddings (trial buckets). 2) Email nurture for free-tier power users. Constraint: need analytics events by Apr 8.
jordan (Sales): Sales asks: 1) Clear pricing collateral for Dedicated vs Hosted (one-pager + objection handling). 2) Playbook for mid-market AE (2 sample threads). Constraint: need sales training week of Apr 18.
sam (RevOps): Ops asks: 1) Quota impact model for Reserved capacity (revenue forecasts). 2) Source attribution setup for PLG to map to funnel. Constraint: need signed-off usage metrics schema by Apr 10.
ana (ana (PM)): @tara @mike @jordan @sam thanks. Propose prioritization: A) Launch collaterals + sales enablement (high touch revenue impact). B) PLG onboarding experiment (growth lead). C) Microsite demo can be staged after A/B. Thoughts?
tara (Product Marketing): +1 on A first. Suggest we split collateral: sales-facing + self-serve assets in parallel. PMM can start sales deck now, microsite after design frees up.
mike (Growth): Agree re: parallel where possible. For PLG experiment we'll need a small engineering spike for event wiring — can engineer time be 1 sprint? @ana can we push budget for a 2-week contract?
jordan (Sales): If sales training is Apr 18-22 we need drafts by Apr 11. Can PMM commit to deck draft by Apr 9?
sam (RevOps): I'll prioritize the attribution schema — will deliver spec by Apr 9. Also can run a quick revenue sensitivity model once we have pricing assumptions.
ana (ana (PM)): Action items: - @tara deck draft by Apr 9 - @sam metrics schema Apr 9 - @mike confirm engineering spike request by EOD today - @jordan confirm training slots Apr 18-22 - I'll book a follow-up on Apr 12 to finalize rollouts. Anyone opposed?
mike (Growth): Confirmed — will post a short request in #eng-product for the spike + cc @ana.
tara (Product Marketing): Not opposed. I'll add a lightweight self-serve checklist for microsite owners so we can stage later.
jordan (Sales): Confirmed slots. Will loop in AEs for feedback session on Apr 13.
sam (RevOps): No objections. Also small ask — can we gate the PLG experiment to <5% initial users to limit infra/cost risk?
nana (ana (PM)): Yes — gate to 3–5% and automatic rollback if error rate >0.5% or latency regressions >20% for 15m window. Marking that as launch criterion.
deploy-bot: scheduled reminder set for Apr 12 10:00 — "Q2 GTM launch review"
ana (PM): Great work — I'll capture notes into the Q2 launch doc and assign JIRA tickets. Thanks everyone :rocket:
